title: Kennedy Causeway Bridge Operational Milestone
summary: NASA records the Kennedy Causeway Bridge as fully operational after the westbound span opened on March 18, 2025, replacing the former two-lane drawbridge.
key_findings: The bridge is the primary access connection for Kennedy and Cape Canaveral employees and visitors.
NASA records both bridge directions as operational after the westbound opening.
A $90 million federal infrastructure grant funded nearly half of the bridge replacement and nearby road widening.
why_it_matters: It supplies a rare completed-and-operational infrastructure record for the corridor.
ftfn_relevance: Closes construction and opening stages for a named access asset.
Links federal, NASA, and Florida capital to an operating facility.
Creates later checks for traffic, reliability, logistics, and mission-support outcomes.
evidence_limits: The record does not provide traffic, reliability, cost, or logistics performance.
It does not prove a causal change in launch capacity or mission outcomes.
